text:
Jana (Support): @here customer AcmeHealth reporting a spike of 5xx from /v1/generate on hosted inference. started ~2024-11-05T14:02Z. customer says ~30% of requests are 500/502, intermittent. request-id: r-8a7c3f. examples attached below. :rotating_light:

Omar (SRE): can you paste the sample response body and the x-request-id/curl they used? also which model route?

Jana (Support): sending minimal repro curl and response body:

curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' \
  -H 'X-Request-ID: r-8a7c3f' \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-3b","prompt":"hi"}'

HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": {
    "message": "upstream error: quota service returned 500",
    "type": "server_error"
  }
}

Jana (Support): customer timestamp: 2024-11-05T14:02:12Z, region eu-west-1, tenant acme-prod. They attached a few more request-ids: r-8a7c3f, r-8a7d21, r-8a8a99.

Li (Platform Eng): assigning to Omar + Marco. hypothesis: quota/rate limiter should return 429/403 if limit; 5xx suggests dependency timeout or misroute. checking quota-orchestrator logs now.

Marco (Infra): looking at envoy/gateway logs for those request ids. snippets:

[2024-11-05T14:02:12Z] request_id=r-8a7c3f upstream_status=000 upstream_error="connect_timeout" route=quota-proxy
[2024-11-05T14:02:12Z] request_id=r-8a7c3f proxy_return=502 message="upstream returned non-2xx"

Marco (Infra): also seeing a spike in outbound connections from quota-proxy to quota-orchestrator with TCP reset count increased.

Nikhil (Oncall): I can confirm quota-orchestrator pods show high GC/heap pressure and a few 503s to redis. k8s events: Liveness probe flaps 14:00-14:06 UTC after last deploy.

Omar (SRE): do we have any recent infra rollouts to gateway or NLB rules around 13:45 UTC? deploy-bot?

deploy-bot: deploy completed: infra/nlb-config v2024.11.05-0312 by infra-deploy (changset 7f3c).

Li (Platform Eng): that nlb config change adjusted route priority for /quota/* to prefer a new internal target-group id-qa-2 (intended for canary validation) — looks like traffic got routed to the canary target-group that isn't fully warmed. canary was mis-tagged and returns 500 on certain auth headers.

Priya (CSE): customer is seeing 5xx across burst traffic windows; they're escalating to SOC. we should issue interim mitigation asap and notify.

Omar (SRE): mitigation plan: 1) revert NLB route-priority to previous target-group (rollback config), 2) scale quota-orchestrator replicas + restart failing pods, 3) add temporary rule in gateway to translate quota dependency timeouts to 429 instead of 500 if header x-service=quota present.

Marco (Infra): rolling back NLB route now (command):

# aws elbv2 modify-rule --rule-arn arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:... --actions '[{"Type":"forward","TargetGroupArn":"tg-old"}]'

Marco (Infra): rollback initiated, should take ~30s for targets to drain and reattach.

Omar (SRE): restarting quota-orchestrator pods in eu-west-1: kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/quota-orchestrator. also bump replicas from 3->6. doing now.

(5m later)

Marco (Infra): rollback complete. targets now showing healthy. envoy logs show route changed back to quota-validator-group.

Marco (Infra): sample envoy lines after rollback:

[2024-11-05T14:06:02Z] request_id=r-8a7c3f upstream_status=200 route=quota-validator upstream_latency=23ms

Jana (Support): customer ack'd reduced 5xx rate to ~1% after rollback. thank you.

Nikhil (Oncall): quota-orchestrator pods restarted and stabilized. redis connection errors stopped after scaling.

Li (Platform Eng): root cause: NLB rule change accidentally promoted canary target-group (unwarmed) to higher priority for /quota/* traffic. that canary returns 500 on a subset of auth headers (edge-case in canary config). resulting path: gateway forwarded to canary -> quota-orchestrator timed out on redis -> gateway surfaced 5xx to customer. Should have returned 429/401 earlier but misroute and dependency timeout masked that.

Omar (SRE): follow-ups (owners):
- Marco: write postmortem note in incidents/ (due EOD) and include the exact rule ARN and change diff.
- Li: add automated canary warm-check to prevent target-group accepting traffic until healthy; also add regression test that quota path returns 4xx for known rate-limited tokens.
- Nikhil: add mapping in gateway to translate orchestration dependency timeouts -> 429 where appropriate (short-term).
- Priya & Jana: customer comms draft and send immediate update: rollback done, working on permanent fix.

Priya (CSE): drafting comms: "we identified a routing configuration change that briefly routed traffic to a canary target causing intermittent 5xx responses. We have rolled back the change and are continuing to monitor. Service impact window ~14:00-14:06 UTC. We'll follow up with a root cause and remediation plan."

Jana (Support): customer wants postmortem + ETA for permanent mitigation (canary gating + gateway mapping). target: postmortem in 48h, mitigation rollout in next maintenance window.

Marco (Infra): posting initial incident note: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1835129876 (stub)

Omar (SRE): repro steps for local/dev to simulate (for the Platform team):
1) point a test host to the canary target-group (or set header X-Canary: true)
2) use the payload and headers below to trigger quota path:

curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate \
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer test-rate-limited-token' \
 -H 'X-Request-ID: repro-01' \
 -H 'X-Canary: true' \
 -d '{"model":"rwd-3b","prompt":"repro"}'

expected: canary responds 500 if unready -> gateway surfaces upstream 502/500. after warm gating, canary should return 200 or 4xx.

Li (Platform Eng): plan to add a preflight warm-check that calls /health/ready and also does a small quota validation call before adding target to routing. timeline: implement + test in 24-48h, deploy following validation.

Nikhil (Oncall): I'll follow up to ensure gateway mapping change is low-risk; we prefer fixing route gating first.

Jana (Support): customer updated: "Thanks for fast rollback, impact reduced, please keep us posted". will update thread when postmortem published.

(End of thread)
